subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should OpenClaw repair the bundled Himalaya skill docs now, or let the active bundled-skill trimming path remove or externalize Himalaya first?
rationale: The stale docs are real current and shipped surface, but VISION.md and the open maintainer-labeled trimming PR point toward moving optional skills out of core, so automation should not choose that boundary.

options.title: Resolve Through Skill Trimming
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor as the product gate, then close this if Himalaya leaves core or patch the docs if it remains bundled.

options.title: Patch Bundled Docs Now
options.body: Keep Himalaya bundled for now and land a focused docs repair with verified Himalaya version scope and the correct upstream save-copy reference.

options.title: Move To External Skill Package
options.body: Ask contributors to maintain Himalaya as a ClawHub skill or bundle and close the core docs issue once users have a clear external package path.

recommendation.title: Resolve Through Skill Trimming
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor as the product gate, then close this if Himalaya leaves core or patch the docs if it remains bundled.

likelyOwner.reason: fuller-stack-dev owns the active PR that removes Himalaya from the bundled starter set, which is the product decision blocking this docs cleanup.
